verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's own pipeline can pull in licensed music and sound effects from stock sources such as Openverse (gh-8). It analyzes the reference's BPM (docs-2), which hints at matching music to pacing. It also supports TTS narration via Yating and ElevenLabs (gh-7). However, the audio is sourced stock rather than generated, and nothing documents how sounds are matched to scenes. Missing for 10: generated (not stock) SFX/ambient/music, documented scene-matched audio placement, any hands-on corroboration.
